research_question: Can the official BPS annual construction-establishment series establish a published Sumatera Barat establishment-count trajectory across 2002-2006, bind the 2003 total to the previously recovered qualification table, and add evidence about the 2005 post-directory-update period without mislabeling published establishment totals as sampling-frame counts?

official_source.title: Statistik Tahunan Perusahaan Konstruksi 2002-2006
official_source.series_basis: BPS states that the 2002-2006 construction statistical series resulted from Annual Construction Establishment Surveys.
official_source.coverage_statement: The Annual Construction Survey covers national construction establishments operating on construction projects in Indonesia.
official_source.table_title_english: NUMBER OF CONSTRUCTION ESTABLISHMENT BY PROVINCE
official_source.measure: published number of construction establishments by province

cross_source_binding.bounded_interpretation: The exact 2003 match binds the published qualification composition to the published annual establishment total for the same province-year. It does not by itself prove that either published total is the exact sampling-frame size used for weighting or historical revision.

next_gate.title: Recover period-specific 2005 qualification composition or explicit frame semantics
next_gate.trigger: Obtain an official BPS source that exposes Sumatera Barat 2005 qualification counts or explicitly identifies comparable old/new sampling-frame counts and definitions.
preferred_sources: Profil Perusahaan Konstruksi di Luar Pulau Jawa 2005 (05230.0610)
another contemporaneous official BPS publication reproducing Sumatera Barat 2005 qualification counts
a contemporaneous BPS methodology or revision note that explicitly links directory/frame changes to weighting or re-estimation

source_boundary.note: This checkpoint freezes published establishment totals and cross-source numeric linkage only. It deliberately does not relabel the totals as sampling-frame counts.
